maddeler.e:
تتعرقبون (form IIq)
# تَتَعَرْقَبُونَ (tataʕarqabūna) /ta.ta.ʕar.qa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تُتَعَرْقَبُونَ (tutaʕarqabūna) /tu.ta.ʕar.qa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
